title: Lakadong Turmeric under Protected Cultivation – Part 10: Yield Parameters, Curcumin Output, and Post-Harvest Processing
excerpt: This article evaluates Lakadong turmeric performance in terms of fresh rhizome yield, dry recovery, and curcumin output, comparing it with commonly cultivated turmeric varieties. It also details critical post-harvest operations including boiling, drying, and curing, which determine final quality and biochemical retention. The section demonstrates why Lakadong turmeric, despite moderate biomass yield, delivers superior curcumin productivity and value when managed and processed correctly under controlled cultivation systems.
